edges.effect_quant: Different designs and subgroups point in different directions, so a single pooled estimate is not the right way to read this edge.
edges.mechanism: Any cognitive effect from subclinical hypothyroidism is expected to be subtle because hormone deficits are modest and often compensated.
edges.summary: What makes this pair believable is not one flashy paper but the way the literature stacks up: the 2025 Mohamed meta analysis in Thyroid Res already points to subclinical hypothyroidism produces mixed findings across studies, and later studies mostly refine the size of the effect rather than overturning it. In practice this reads more like a real risk signal than a one-off finding.
edges.caveats: Subgroup differences, dose thresholds, and competing mechanisms likely explain why the literature does not settle into one clean direction.
